findings.title: Match statement lacks a comment explaining the change
findings.body: The new match statement replaces the previous `RETRYABLE_STATES` constant and its membership check. The change is non-obvious because the constant is removed and the logic is now inline. Add a comment explaining why the match statement is used and what the cases represent to maintain clarity for future maintainers.
findings.suggestion:
# Retry only if the status is "failed" or "cancelled" and retries are available
    match status:

summary.problem: The refactor removes a named constant without adding a comment to explain the new inline logic.
summary.done_well: The match statement correctly implements the same retry logic with fewer lines and no external dependency.
